specimens.title: S#1589, Central Asia, Turgesh, cash-like coin, m/a
specimens.description: Thick and heavy specimen. Compare with Z# 33694 , 189825 , 189826 and 189860 . Metal composition is : Cu 89.1810, Zn 0.3187, Sn 3.7445, As 0.7834, Sb 0.9928, Pb 2.7717, Fe 0.1788, Mn 1.7085, Ni 0.3105, Cd,Co,Bi all are under detection limits, Sum 99.9899 %, XRF data. So we see As-Sb bearing, low led and low tin bronze. Manganese content may be connected with attempts of previous owner to darken the coin with using of KMnO4+CuSO4 solution. Patination is sulphide type - in some points sulphur content reach up to 3 %.

specimens.description: Compare with Z# 33693 , 189825 , 189826 and 189860 . Metal colour and composition are strong different from #33693. Zinc and stibium absent here, lead and tin contents elevated, copper content is lower more than 1/3. Apparently alloy is heterogeneous (liquated). Patination of the coin is phosphate type (up to 2.8 % P) and presumably represented by pyromorphite Pb5[PO4]3Cl.
